title: Neural Combinatorial Optimization with Heavy Decoder: Toward Large Scale Generalization
actually_read_sections: arXiv v2; Sections 3.1-3.2; Section 4 partial-solution training; Section 6.2 and Tables 3-5
relevance: 主要计算位于随剩余子问题变化的 heavy decoder; 浅 encoder 不代表完整候选知识
limits: NeurIPS 2023 论文的2024年v2; 实际求解泛化不是选择器证据; 原生剩余状态不能靠查询真实路线取得

title: DIFUSCO: Graph-based Diffusion Solvers for Combinatorial Optimization
relevance: 解变量边扩散与图共同决定计算; 解码和后处理是候选行为的一部分
limits: 单次隐藏特征不代表完整原生质量; 不得用查询真实解加噪; 原论文解码配置不等于当前部署配置

title: Matrix Encoding Networks for Neural Combinatorial Optimization
actually_read_sections: Sections 3.1-3.3; Section 4 ATSP configuration and decoder/inference
relevance: 行列双角色与矩阵关系的类型化计算; 解释 ATSP 表示和已有 R102 覆盖
limits: MatNet encoder 与 FROM/TO 已试过; 多起点完整求解的收益不能当成免费选择特征

title: Rethinking Light Decoder-based Solvers for Vehicle Routing Problems
actually_read_sections: Sections 2.1-2.3; Equations 1-6 and static-embedding versus state-conditioned policy discussion
relevance: 区分 ReLD 静态节点知识与动态条件/可行集合; 限定 R94 donor 所代表的知识
limits: 读取 arXiv v1; 求解策略分析不认证选择平台原因; 不用于推荐另一个 ReLD decoder 或局部专家

title: CaDA: Cross-Problem Routing Solver with Constraint-Aware Dual-Attention
actually_read_sections: arXiv v1; Sections IV-A-IV-D; Section V-E and Table IV
relevance: 约束 prompt 在编码中与全局/稀疏分支交互; 给多约束任务的异构表示以具体依据
limits: 实际读取2024年预印本而非后续正式修订; 16题求解消融不证明跨候选选择收益; task prompt 本身不是实例优势

title: Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Solver via Mixture of Specialized Experts under State-Decomposable MDP
actually_read_sections: Sections 3 and 4.1-4.3 including Assumptions 1-2 and theorem statements; Sections 5.1 and 5.3; Section 6
relevance: 逐层逐 token 复用原生专家计算不同于静态方法 ID; 显示知识组合的条件与代价
limits: 理论需最优基策略及较强表示假设; 未逐行核验附录证明; 构造统一 solver 不等于选择固定候选; 不恢复 B 任务删除项

title: Emergent Correspondence from Image Diffusion
actually_read_sections: Sections 3 and 4.1-4.2; Appendices B/C timestep-layer selection and noise averaging passages
relevance: 提示扩散中间特征与抽取位置有关; 明确 DIFT 与 DIFUSCO 的变量差异
limits: DIFT 给已观察图像加噪而不是给未知解加噪; 不能据此把查询路线送入选择器; 独立噪声抽取只是新假说

title: Transformer Neural Processes: Uncertainty-Aware Meta Learning Via Sequence Modeling
actually_read_sections: Sections 2.1-3.3; Sections 4.3-4.5; metadata cross-checked with PMLR 162 nguyen22b
relevance: 上下文输入标签绑定及排列约束; 支持把条件预测函数作为学习对象
limits: 实际读取 arXiv v2; wheel bandit 有参数化任务族和在线奖励; 不是固定 TRAIN 上下文的 whole18 单次选择证明

title: PRODIGY: Enabling In-context Learning Over Graphs
actually_read_sections: Sections 2.1-2.3; Sections 3.1-3.2; Sections 4.3-4.5; Appendix E ablation discussion
relevance: prompt graph 中输入标签关系可被预训练为推理过程; 不只是冻结向量近邻
limits: 主要为共享源图上的节点/边任务; 标签节点有信息瓶颈; 未验证独立路由整图间的精细 winner 比较

title: Context-aware Graph Meta-learning
actually_read_sections: Sections 3.1-3.4; Section 4.1; Sections 4.5-4.7 and Table 3; Section 5
relevance: 图结构参与上下文学习有原始消融证据; 语义残差的强影响提供迁移反例
limits: AAAI 2026; PLM 文本节点及共享图任务; 无文本图列为未来工作; 不能把原论文增益外推到路由选择

title: Using Time-Series Privileged Information for Provably Efficient Learning of Prediction Models
actually_read_sections: Sections 2-3.1; Algorithm 1 and Assumptions 1-2; Theorem 1 statement; Sections 4.2-4.3; venue metadata from PMLR 151
relevance: 训练可见后续状态而预测只用初始输入; 给过程知识的条件性样本效率依据
limits: 方差结论依赖 Gaussian-linear Markov 设定与噪声条件; 非线性压缩 native 状态不自动满足; 不保证 winner 或 regret

title: Rethinking Knowledge Transfer in Learning Using Privileged Information
actually_read_sections: arXiv v1; Section 3; Sections 4.1-4.2 including generalized distillation and TRAM controls; Section 5
relevance: 知识转移收益可能由训练不足或结构变化解释; 强教师不等于有效学生
limits: 读取2024年v1而非后续期刊版; 特定反例不能否定所有 LUPI 或原生过程监督

title: Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Combinatorial Optimisation
actually_read_sections: Sections 4.1-4.3; Sections 5.1-5.3 including transfer strategies and scale results
relevance: 冻结/微调/双处理器的差异; 算法执行能力与下游迁移不是一回事
limits: LoG 2023 / PMLR 2024; 研究 TSP 求解而非固定候选选择; 大规模外推衰退限制通用过程预训练叙事

title: The Value Equivalence Principle for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
relevance: 用指定决策函数上的等价性限制不必要的全状态模拟
limits: MDP Bellman 作用与期望回报对象不等于 native winner 概率或 Oracle 归一化 regret; 本稿仅借鉴原则

title: Deep Learning as a Competitive Feature-Free Approach for Automated Algorithm Selection on the Traveling Salesperson Problem
actually_read_sections: Section 1 problem scope; Sections 5.1-5.2; Table 2 context; Section 6 opening
relevance: 直接算法选择先例; 图像/MST/近邻表征和多通道组合并非必然获益; 召回与误选成本可冲突
limits: 仅 EAX/LKH 两候选和演化 TSP1000; PAR10 时间目标不同于当前成本; 不移植其阈值调节或评估制度
